ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the images: Figure 3 is the curve chart of China's population dependency coefficient. The curve is relatively high in the early period, then gradually declines and reaches a relatively low level near the trough, and then continues to rise toward future years, indicating that in the future the pressure on the working-age population to support children and provide for the elderly will increase. Figure 4 is the population age composition chart, and it also shows that the proportion of the working-age population is relatively high, while the proportion of the elderly population has an upward trend. Then reason: the question asks “what measures should be taken to improve labor efficiency.” The rise in the population dependency coefficient means that the relative burden on the labor force is increasing, and it is necessary to improve the output efficiency of each unit of laborer; therefore, labor efficiency should be improved through technological progress and improvement of production methods.
